item.title: CVE-2026-136694 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | A weakness has been identified in eosphoros-ai DB-GPT up to 0.8.2. This impacts the function skill_upload of the file packages/dbgpt-app/src/dbgpt_app/openapi/api_v1/agentic_data_api.py of the component Skill Upload Handler. Executing a manipulation of the argument filename can lead to path traversal. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 0.8.3 will fix this issue. This patch is called fc6a5017d5a8509d34700694bbd8a637bde311fb. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component. This is a regression of CVE-2026-51862 because the fix shipped in 0.8.1 was reverted in 0.8.2 and the corrected code exists only on the unreleased main branch.

item.title: CVE-2026-136862 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.0
item.description:
Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.0 | In Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server Credential Helper versions 0.1.0 to 0.2.0, as shipped with Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server versions 0.65.0 to 0.83.0, the Git credential helper selects stored credentials by re-parsing the requested URL with a regular expression that can be confused by `:` and `@` characters in the URL path. An attacker who can make an ORT Server worker fetch a crafted Git URL, for example through a submodule of a repository that is analyzed, can obtain credentials stored for a different host, such as `github.com`, which Git then sends to the attacker-controlled server.
The issue is fixed in Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server Credential Helper 0.2.1 and Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server 0.84.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-136903 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8 | Open Babel through 3.2.1 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in OBForceField::Setup() that leaves stored constraints bound to freed atoms when set up with an empty molecule. Attackers can supply a molecule file yielding an empty molecule so later SteepestDescent() or ConjugateGradients() calls read freed memory, causing crashes or incorrect results.

item.title: CVE-2026-136904 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | POCO C++ Libraries through 1.15.4 contain a denial of service vulnerability in InflatingStreamBuf::reset() and InflatingInputStream::reset() that fails to discard unconsumed compressed input after decompression errors. Attackers can supply one corrupt zlib, gzip or zip-deflate stream to applications reusing an InflatingInputStream, causing all later stream reads, including valid ones, to fail.

item.title: CVE-2026-136905 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | CESNET libyang through 6.4.13 contains an incomplete cleanup vulnerability in ly_out_reset() in src/out.c that tests a stale errno ESPIPE value after a successful seek. Applications reusing one output handler for different clients rewind but do not truncate the file, leaking leftover bytes of a previous client's output.

item.title: CVE-2026-136906 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | libyang through 6.4.13 contains a file descriptor leak in ly_in_new_filepath() and ly_in_filepath() in src/in.c that fails to close descriptors when file mapping fails. Attackers who can supply files parsed through lyd_parse_data_path() or lys_parse_path() can repeatedly submit empty files to exhaust descriptors, causing later file and socket operations to fail.

item.title: CVE-2026-136907 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | CESNET libyang through 6.4.13 contains a return of wrong status code vulnerability in ly_in_filepath() in src/in.c that reports success when a new file cannot be opened or mapped. Attackers who make an application switch a reused input handler to a nonexistent or empty file cause it to parse the previously loaded file's data as the requested input.

item.title: CVE-2026-136908 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | libyang through 6.4.13 contains a release of invalid pointer vulnerability in ly_in_memory() and ly_in_memory_chunk() in src/in.c that return the current read position instead of the previous start address. Attackers supplying YANG data parsed from a heap buffer can cause applications freeing the returned pointer to pass an interior address to free(), aborting the process.

item.title: CVE-2026-136909 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8 | Assimp 5.1.0 through 6.0.6 contains a memory leak vulnerability in AMFImporter::ParseFile that overwrites the previous XML parser pointer without releasing it. item.title: CVE-2026-136911 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | Boost.JSON 1.75.0 through 1.92.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in monotonic_resource::release() because it does not reset next_size_ when returning blocks upstream. item.title: CVE-2026-136912 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9

item.title: CVE-2026-136913 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1

item.title: CVE-2026-136917 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Part-DB (Part-DB-server) before 2.20.6 contains an open redirect vulnerability in several controllers that pass user-supplied _redirect or redirect_back parameters to redirect() without validating local paths. item.title: CVE-2026-136918 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | FCEUX before 2.8.0 contains an integer overflow in SetBoardName() in src/unif.cpp that allows crafted UNIF ROM files to write past a heap buffer. item.title: CVE-2026-136921 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | nconf through 1.0.0-beta.2 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in the Memory store merge() function in lib/nconf/stores/memory.js that lacks __proto__ key rejection. item.title: CVE-2026-136922 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | PyBioNetGen 0.8.7 contains a code injection vulnerability in ParameterBlock.add_item() and ModelBlock.add_item() that allows attackers to execute Python code by passing parameter expressions to sympy.sympify(). item.title: CVE-2026-136923 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | asar-py before 0.1.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in AsarArchive.extract() and extract_archive() that allows attackers to write files outside the destination directory via crafted archive headers. item.title: CVE-2026-66419 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Remote Mouse for macOS before 3.511 contains a URL scheme validation bypass vulnerability in the opn sub-command of the web command handler, SystemCommandHandler::performWebPanelRemoteFunction_, which checks only for the presence of http:// or https:// substrings rather than validating the actual URL scheme before passing input to NSWorkspace.openURL. Attackers who can reach the TCP command service on port 1978 can send a crafted file:// URL containing a decoy http:// substring to launch arbitrary local applications, open local files with their default handlers, or invoke other applications' registered URL schemes as the logged-in user, requiring no authentication unless a connection password is configured.

item.title: CVE-2026-82489 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | openIMIS before 2026-10 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in the report module (openimis-be-report_py) where the /api/report/reportbro/preview endpoint evaluates printIf expressions server-side using simpleeval with an insufficient name-prefix blocklist. An attacker can craft an expression that reaches sys.modules['os'] via datetime.sys to execute arbitrary operating-system commands as root, and can also exploit the same endpoint's key parameter for unauthenticated arbitrary file read, enabling full host compromise including exposure of database credentials and JWT signing keys.

item.title: CVE-2026-82490 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the OpenSearch reporting dashboard proxy, where the nginx auth_request only verifies login status without checking the declared right before attaching a hardcoded administrative credential to the proxied request, and the backend OpenSearch cluster has its security plugin disabled via a hardcoded compose setting. Any authenticated account, including self-registered or zero-rights users, can exploit this flaw to gain read, write, and delete access to the OpenSearch cluster.

item.title: CVE-2026-82491 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | openIMIS before 2026-10 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the core export mixin (openimis-be-core_py, core/gql/export_mixin.py) that allows authenticated users with a single ordinary read right to traverse arbitrary foreign key relations by supplying caller-controlled dotted field paths that are rewritten into Django ORM syntax without an allow-list. Attackers can exploit this to export another user's JWT signing key via a path such as user_created.i_user.private_key, enabling them to forge valid authenticated sessions for other accounts, including administrators, without detection through failed-login events or invalidation by password reset.

item.title: CVE-2026-82492 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | openIMIS before 2026-10 contains an improper validation vulnerability in the deduplication service (openimis-be-deduplication_py, deduplication/services.py) that allows a caller holding only the narrow right 170001 to bypass column path validation by exploiting the fact that only the first segment of a dotted relation path is checked before the full unvalidated path is used in the query. Attackers can supply a crafted dotted column path such as user_created__i_user__private_key to traverse relations and retrieve an administrator's JWT signing key, enabling forgery of a valid administrator session without a password that survives password resets and generates no failed-login event.

item.title: CVE-2026-82493 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the report module's overrideReport GraphQL mutation, which stores submitted report definitions without proper validation before rendering them with the simpleeval expression evaluator. An attacker holding only limited report add, edit, or query privileges can craft a printIf expression that leverages the datetime module to reach os.system functions, bypassing the name-prefix blocklist to execute arbitrary operating-system commands as root whenever the malicious report is later rendered by any viewer, including administrators or scheduled jobs.

item.title: CVE-2026-82494 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the FHIR R4 module (openimis-be-api_fhir_r4_py) that allows an authenticated attacker with limited district-level access to receive subscription notifications for data outside their authorized scope due to the absence of row-level security checks such as has_perms, get_queryset, ROW_SECURITY, district, or health-facility scoping on the notification delivery path. Attackers can register a standing FHIR subscription to continuously receive claim data and can further direct notification pushes to internal network addresses.

item.title: CVE-2026-82495 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.2
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.2 | openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a broken access control vulnerability in the FHIR R4 module that allows any authenticated attacker to delete Coverage policy records due to an empty permissions_delete list being vacuously granted by user.has_perms([]). Attackers can issue a DELETE request to the Coverage/<uuid>/ endpoint to permanently and irrecoverably remove insurance policy records.
